data_objects.name: global_grid_environmental_timeseries
data_objects.meaning: Seven wide CSV tables: monthly lwd, precipitation, pres, spechumidity, swd, and temp series named for 2021 through 2023, plus a daily temp series named for 2023. Inspected representatives use dates as rows and coordinate-like grid-cell labels as measurement columns.

data_objects.name: selected_location_daily_temperature
data_objects.meaning: A separate 11-column date-indexed CSV whose ten measurement columns are labeled Location_1 through Location_10. The filename identifies the measurements as daily temp for 2023, but the locations are not mapped to coordinates in the inspected evidence.

data_objects.name: grid_cell_metadata
data_objects.meaning: A one-sheet workbook with worksheet dimension A1:BP61201. The inspected header begins with grid-cell ID, latitude range, longitude range, country, and mean elevation, followed by numerous named land-cover and climate-category fields.

data_objects.name: relief_png_collection
data_objects.meaning: A collection of 57,300 PNG files named relief_<latitude token>_<longitude token>.png. The coordinate-like filename tokens organize the collection, but no embedded georeferencing or calibrated pixel meaning was established.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar-date row label encoded as YYYY-MM-DD in the inspected representatives. Monthly examples use a month-end date and the daily example uses a daily date; interval semantics, timezone, and calendar metadata are not stated.

variables.name: coordinate-like grid-cell columns
variables.meaning: Spatial measurement columns labeled with latitude-like N/S and longitude-like E/W tokens. Each inspected representative has 64,800 such columns in addition to Date; its first and last labels are 90S_180W and 89N_179W.

variables.name: temp
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell measurement identified as temp by the filename.

variables.name: temp
variables.meaning: Daily grid-cell measurement identified as temp by the filename.

variables.name: precipitation
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell precipitation measurement as named by the filename; accumulation or averaging semantics are not stated.

variables.name: pres
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell measurement identified as pres by the filename; the abbreviation is not expanded in the inspected evidence.

variables.name: spechumidity
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell measurement identified as spechumidity by the filename.

variables.name: lwd
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell measurement identified as lwd by the filename; the abbreviation is not expanded in the inspected evidence.

variables.name: swd
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell measurement identified as swd by the filename; the abbreviation is not expanded in the inspected evidence.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar-date row label encoded as YYYY-MM-DD in the inspected rows.

variables.name: Location_1 through Location_10
variables.meaning: Ten opaque location-specific measurement columns in a file named as daily temp; no coordinates or location-key mapping were observed.

variables.name: ID
variables.meaning: Grid-cell-style identifier combining latitude-like and longitude-like tokens, for example 84S_180W.

variables.name: Latitude range
variables.meaning: A comma-separated signed latitude boundary pair; the first sampled record contains -85,-84.

variables.name: Longitude range
variables.meaning: A comma-separated signed longitude boundary pair; the first sampled record contains -180, -179.

variables.name: Country
variables.meaning: Country or territory name associated with the grid-cell record; both sampled records contain Antarctica.

variables.name: Mean elevation
variables.meaning: Mean elevation value associated with the grid-cell record; the physical unit is not stated in the inspected header.

variables.name: land-cover category fields
variables.meaning: Repeated numeric fields named for water and land-cover categories, including cropland, snow_and_ice, grassland, vegetation, tree, shrubland, bare-area, mosaic, urban, and flooded-cover categories. The two sampled rows contain values between 0 and 1, but the scale is not explicitly documented.

variables.name: climate-category fields
variables.meaning: Fields named for climate categories in the inspected header, including dry_steppe_hot_arid, polar_frost, and snow_fully_humid_warm_summer. Their encoding was not established by the sampled rows.

variables.name: filename coordinate-like tokens
variables.meaning: Latitude-like N/S and longitude-like E/W tokens embedded in each PNG filename. Inventory parsing found signed token ranges -79 through 80 for latitude and -180 through 179 for longitude; filename tokens alone do not establish georeferencing.

variables.name: PNG pixel values
variables.meaning: Image pixel values in files labeled as relief imagery; channel count, scale, calibration, nodata encoding, and physical meaning were not inspected.

structure.description: The inspected global time-series representatives are wide tables with one row per Date and 64,800 coordinate-like measurement columns. The two monthly samples begin at 2021-01-31, while the daily temperature sample begins at 2023-01-01.

The separate selected-location table has Date plus Location_1 through Location_10. Its opaque location labels do not provide a demonstrated join to workbook IDs, grid-cell headers, or relief filenames.

The metadata workbook has one sheet, Sheet1, with declared dimension A1:BP61201 (68 columns and 61,201 rows including the header extent). The first two data records have distinct ID values and pair each ID with coordinate ranges, country, elevation, and category-valued metadata.

The relief inventory contains 160 distinct latitude-like tokens and 360 longitude-like tokens but only 57,300 PNGs rather than every possible pairing. Of the latitude tokens, 140 have 360 files, 10 have 350, and 10 have 340, so the filename grid is not complete.

Coordinate-like identifiers occur in the global time-series headers, workbook ID field, and relief filenames, but their observed coverage differs: inspected time-series headers span labels from 90S_180W to 89N_179W, the workbook sample starts with 84S identifiers paired with -85,-84 latitude ranges, and relief filename latitude tokens span -79 through 80. Complete one-to-one alignment is therefore not established.

uncertainties: No explicit units were observed for temp, precipitation, pres, spechumidity, lwd, swd, mean elevation, or the metadata category values; units are left null.
The temporal labels do not establish whether monthly values are instantaneous, averaged, accumulated, or otherwise aggregated, nor do they establish timezone or calendar conventions.
Only representative temperature and precipitation CSV rows were inspected. The corresponding layout of the other named monthly files was not directly sampled.
Workbook inspection was limited to the first three rows and first 40 of 68 columns. The meanings and encodings of the remaining 28 columns are unresolved.
No relief PNG was opened for image metadata, so pixel dimensions, dtype, channels, CRS, nodata, calibration, and physical units are unknown.
No complete key-coverage comparison was performed among workbook IDs, time-series grid labels, and relief filenames; coordinate-like naming alone does not prove alignment.
The ten Location_1 through Location_10 columns have no observed coordinate or metadata mapping.
Missing-value encodings were not established by the bounded samples.
annotation_notes: Evidence was restricted to the declared public directory and the required dataset-semantics and Earth-observation treatment references; task descriptions, private data, gold data, graders, outputs, and existing annotations were not used.
Physical inventory: 57,309 files comprising 57,300 PNGs, eight CSVs, and one XLSX workbook. Seven CSVs are under timeseries; the root contains the selected-location CSV and workbook.

Content inspection remained bounded to two rows from representative CSVs and three rows by 40 columns from the workbook. Image characterization uses only inventory, extension, directory, and filename evidence.
Variable families are summarized where the workbook or grid tables are too wide to enumerate usefully, and unsupported interpretations are recorded as uncertainties.
